title: PRODUCT DESIGNER & AI BUILDER
brandingStatement: Bridging technology and the people who use it
brandingDescription: Designing natural interactions that make unfamiliar technology feel understandable—especially as AI reshapes established behaviors.
bio: I am a product and interaction designer working across automotive HMI, design systems, multimodal experiences, and AI-assisted products. I translate complex technology into interactions that feel understandable and require less learning from users.

philosophy.heading: My Philosophy
philosophy.body: Technology should adapt to people—not ask people to learn its internal logic. I use clear information structures, contextual feedback, and natural interaction patterns to reduce that gap.

aiThinking.heading: AI Hybrid Thinking
aiThinking.body: I use AI for visual exploration, prompt-to-UI prototyping, cross-tool handoffs, and iterative building while keeping product judgment, content truth, and final decisions human-owned.

experience.description: Designing AI learning flows and feedback mechanisms while exploring rapid validation for AI-native products.
Worked across multimodal cockpit experiences, voice interaction, ADAS feedback, global HMI adaptation, and a cross-platform design system.
Contributed to automotive HMI projects, multimodal interaction, AI-tool concepts, spatial-computing guidance, and user research.
